goal: Attempt next FloatLib champion, compare against current incumbent; preserve all-input exactness and complete official public suite acceptance.
priority: Measured time share times realizable reduction, then implementation and verification cost; prefer materially different high-upside mechanisms over repeating failed local variants.

research.scope: math, exactness bridges, Lean draft and counterexamples

development.scope: implementation, integration, Git and CI for root worktree; current shared codex status

free.scope: independent math, exploration, development or CI; human starts this participant

authorization.source: Human requested three-agent eight-hour collaboration and CI-based Lean, with low local resource usage.

resources.local_cpu_work: bounded lightweight scripts, no Lean or full compilation, no broad disk scans

handoff: One short current status per owner; immutable per-topic messages with exact artifact paths and hashes; read at candidate/proof/CI/close checkpoints. Research does not write shared codex/status.md or stage, switch, push or dispatch independently in the shared root worktree.
acceptance: Freeze exact combined source and run complete original gate plus paired public timing and at least two additional input groups for adoption. Discovery samples and independent confirmation remain distinct. Do not claim official champion/admission without official evaluation.
end_policy: Continue throughout authorized window. Stop new long experiments with adequate acceptance margin. Already-started CI and necessary receipt collection finish to terminal state, even if they cross the window end; do not start fresh research after deadline.
